changes: Inspect every same-UID process for project FDs and mappings.
Fail closed for unknown inaccessible processes; permit only exact manifest-bound ssh-agent identities, rechecked at denial.
Refresh live snapshot immediately before unlink loop, then every 256 files or 10 seconds after completed scan.
Precompute live directory membership and exclude an exact project-root directory handle.
Use runtime checks unaffected by Python optimization, reject retained-target overlap, and preserve receipts through exclusive creation.
limitations: Live checks are sampled and do not provide atomic exclusion of concurrent writers.
Only audited immutable obsolete directories may be used.
